deployments_detail.use: AI kiln (firing furnace) automation using temp/pressure data at domestic factories (from FY2026)
AI ship-scheduling optimization (claimed cement-industry first, with Grid Inc.); "PreSLump" concrete slump prediction AI
AI-based lifespan prediction for infrastructure using sensors, drones, and image processing
AI automation for rotary kiln operation
PreSLump AI for real-time concrete slump value prediction [PreSLump AI]

AI-powered ship allocation optimization system for coastal cement transport; analyzes large volumes of transportation data to generate optimal multi-month vessel scheduling plans considering fuel, route efficiency and loading capacity. First such system in Japan's cement industry, in operation since May 2025. [GRID Inc.]
deployments_detail.value: expected ~10% reduction in fuel consumption at planning stage; planning time cut by more than 50% vs manual

deployments_detail.use: PreSLump AI: real-time concrete slump prediction using deep-learning image recognition of concrete in the mixer, automating quality measurement. Commercialized/sold for ready-mix concrete plants (built on the AI slump-prediction technology first developed in 2019). [Taiheiyo Cement / Pacific Systems]

TQPS (Taiheiyo Cement Quality Predictive System): neural-network models that predict cement strength and quality characteristics from analytical values and production operating conditions, without waiting for materials to age; used to support production/quality management at factories. [Taiheiyo Cement (in-house neural network)]

AI-based automatic operation/control of rotary cement kilns (firing furnaces) at domestic plants; AI trained on temperature, pressure and other in-kiln data plus a 3D digital map of plant equipment to learn and replace skilled operator control amid workforce aging. Full rollout planned from fiscal year 2026.

AI + drone predictive maintenance / failure-prediction system at Kumagaya plant: drones with cameras inspect kiln steel-ring surfaces (detecting ~1mm anomalies) while vibration/temperature/flow sensors on 30+ machines feed AI time-series analysis to predict equipment failures 1-2 weeks in advance. In full operation since fiscal 2022.
deployments_detail.value: detects anomalies as small as ~1mm; failure detection 1-2 weeks before occurrence

deployments_detail.use: Autonomous indoor inspection drones for plant equipment: drones self-estimate position from camera imagery of surrounding objects to fly autonomously in GPS-denied indoor areas of cement plants, extending equipment inspection/monitoring beyond outdoor drone use.

Group company Taiheiyo Material adopted the User Local ChatAI enterprise generative-AI platform to search/summarize large volumes of technical documents, retrieve past construction cases, support sales proposal drafting and proofread product manuals; deployed across technical development, sales and management departments. [User Local ChatAI (ChatGPT / Gemini)]

Corporate use of generative AI for preparing materials/documents and creating meeting minutes at HQ/back-office; run as a pilot/proof-of-concept to verify practical applicability for broader business use.
Sales DX program using digital technologies including RPA and generative AI to improve sales/business-process efficiency and strengthen customer-response capability. [RPA / generative AI (unnamed)]
